scope: P3-T5R IDSSE development branch (T5R2 lock and later)
rule: Legacy machine keys are kept for artifact/script compatibility. Display names and interpretations below are authoritative for all current and future canonical docs and reports. Historical reports are not rewritten; they are covered by this addendum.

aliases.allowed_interpretation: auxiliary match-half/period context accessibility probe on z_ctx; evidence that z_ctx retains some absolute context information
aliases.promotion_rule: must not be used as the primary reason for candidate promotion in T5R4 Round 2 or later

aliases.construction: response-blind geometric construction: positives share near centered internal geometry with far absolute centroids; negatives share near absolute centroids with far centered internal geometry
aliases.allowed_interpretation: intrinsic structural accessibility stress test / proxy on z_mode
aliases.ceiling_warning: Procrustes analytic control reaches ~0.9372 valid ranking accuracy; the task is strongly geometry-solvable, so small gains near the ceiling must not alone justify promotion
aliases.promotion_rule: candidate promotion must not rest on ranking gains of 0.1%-0.5% near the Procrustes ceiling

aliases.definition: Spearman correlation between natural-pair internal-geometry distance and latent distance
aliases.allowed_interpretation: non-interventional geometry accessibility proxy on IDSSE development data
forbidden_interpretation: replication of the legacy P3 geometry-response (intervention-response) mechanism on IDSSE
aliases.compatibility: both keys are emitted with identical values; when the legacy key is written, it must carry legacy_alias_only semantics

aliases.implementation: pooled z -> parameter-free LayerNorm -> existing context heads; not a layer-wise head placement
aliases.allowed_interpretation: control showing task accuracy can stay high while the geometry proxy drops; accuracy alone cannot judge representation geometry
aliases.round2_status: does not enter Round 2; the head_placement/readout-normalization axis is closed

aliases.round1_setting: context_weight x1.5 or intrinsic_weight x1.5 on separate optimizer steps
aliases.display_name: exploratory loss-scale probe under update imbalance
aliases.allowed_interpretation: Round 1 motivates testing training balance; it does not identify a precise mechanism magnitude
aliases.reason: context and intrinsic use separate optimizer steps (about 361 vs 59 batches per epoch, ratio about 6.12:1); Adam adaptively normalizes pure gradient scale, so loss scaling cannot be read as a precise influence ratio
aliases.round2_status: superseded by the encoder update-allocation axis with matched total optimizer steps
